title: Clinical supervision
body:
I offer clinical supervision to other therapists and to colleagues working in the helping professions.

Supervision isn't only about bringing your client work; it's about bringing yourself too, so we can explore that work more collaboratively.

I hold a Level 6 Diploma in Clinical Supervision (2022) and I'm an NCPS Accredited Member. If you work with sexual behaviour, harmful sexual behaviour or risk, that is territory I have specific training in; see the qualifications below.
